description: Four cuts or absolute values of the same kind in 2HP, the kind chosen by one switch

params.text: Chooses what happens to each signal: Abs makes negative voltages positive, Ct- replaces negative voltages with 0V, Ct+ replaces positive ones with 0V

inputs.text: One of the four signals to be cut or made positive

outputs.text: Carries the input of the same letter under the chosen rule

notes: in Ct- or Ct+ a bipolar signal comes out flat for half of each cycle, which is the point when a CV should push a knob one way only
menu: Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Gate-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming gate counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Gate-high output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while high, 10V unless you change it
Gate-low output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while low, 0V unless you change it
